scientific_question: Can exact source-view instance co-membership teach one scene-independent region-pair probability that filters target-blind text seeds into object-consistent multi-region unions?

motivation.identified_gap: Appearance, geometry and generic graph connectivity do not identify whether two semantically plausible regions belong to the same object instance.
motivation.forbidden_response: No LERF scene, label, query, target metric or per-scene threshold may be used to define or tune co-membership.

source_instance_evidence.dataset: ScanNet v2 official filtered 2D instance annotations

evidence_aggregation.pixel_alignment: resize each exact frame's uint instance map directly to exact raster HxW with nearest-neighbor, then use row-major pixel_id
evidence_aggregation.primitive_instance_mass: sum exact_hit_weight by gaussian_id and positive instance_id across all bound source views
evidence_aggregation.region_instance_mass: sum primitive_instance_mass over the AcceptedV2 token_mask-selected region core rows
evidence_aggregation.dominant_instance: argmax positive instance mass with smallest-ID deterministic tie break
evidence_aggregation.instance_purity: dominant positive instance mass divided by total positive instance mass
evidence_aggregation.instance_label_coverage: total positive instance mass divided by all exact visible mass including label zero

candidate_union: top16 frozen AcceptedV2 descriptor cosine neighbors per region
top16 region-centroid Euclidean neighbors per region
AcceptedV2 anchor pairs joined by one frozen support-graph edge
pair_authority.same_instance_target: both dominant IDs positive and exactly equal
pair_authority.target_weight: geometric mean label coverage times product of instance purities
pair_authority.zero_target_weight: excluded from training denominator but retained in authority audit

model_and_selection.model: one shared normalized linear logistic pair head; no scene embedding and no query input
model_and_selection.feature_normalization: coordinate median and 1.4826*MAD fit on the four source-train scenes only
model_and_selection.loss: equal-scene, class-balanced, evidence-weighted binary cross entropy
model_and_selection.optimizer: AdamW seed0 lr=0.001 weight_decay=0.0001 maximum_epochs=100 patience=12
model_and_selection.checkpoint_selection: minimum source-validation scene-macro weighted BCE, epoch0 identity-logit candidate included
model_and_selection.decision_threshold: single global threshold maximizing source-validation scene-macro evidence-weighted F1 over the fixed grid 0.05 through 0.95 step 0.05; lowest threshold wins exact ties

query_interface.input: target-blind text seed region indices plus pair probabilities on the same candidate-pair construction
query_interface.operation: retain seed-connected regions through edges at or above the single frozen source-validation threshold
